marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Homicide detective Sean Nault is a cop on a parallel Earth where technology is powered exclusively by Magic. When he begins investigating a series of baffling murders he discovers that they are being committed by a means he's never seen before: science. With the aid of Lenoir, a member of the subculture of 'pragmatists' who believe science is more than the stuff of mytyhs, and the 130-year-old soccerer Winston Churchill, Sean uncovers an ominous plot that will lead him to another dimension and the realization that, unless he prevents it, both Earths could well be destroyed."--Container
